changelog: Click-to-call: highlight a phone number (or right-click a phone link) on any website and pick "Call with Roofr Assist". The dialer opens a card showing who it is (Form Leads row, Roofr job and next appointment, LSA / Angi lead, a waiting Ava booking, CTM calls) and calls them from the right source, with the double-tap and the usual wrap-up. A number not on the sheet can be added to Form Leads after the call, unless they are already a Roofr customer or an LSA / Angi lead.
